definition: Jiliang Tang is a Chinese-born computer scientist and a University Foundation Professor of Computer Science and Engineering at Michigan State University, where he is the director of the Data Science and Engineering (DSE) Lab.
details: His research expertise is in data mining and machine learning.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Jiliang Tang.
